div.div:
mechanism gate — e2e/resource-back-spa.spec.ts (new)
toHaveURL alone is blind: a full reload also lands the URL. The spec pins the mechanism with two independent signals:
1. memory sentinel: window.__spaSentinel = crypto.randomUUID() before the click, read back after — a reload drops the window (undefined)
2. document-request counter: page.on(request), resourceType document, attached after goto — a reload always issues one before the target paints
plus the outcome floor: URL arrives and the landed face marker renders. Faces probed: agent-detail (the reported one) and skills.
